page_title: BHA 0-2 MNU | Brighton v Manchester Utd 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van Hecke J. P. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Yellow card. Casemiro (Manchester United) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

88' 0 - 2 Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Jason Steele is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 0:2.
87' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) receives a yellow card.
86' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

85' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is out of play. Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner.
81' That will be all from Carlos Baleba who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Billy Gilmour (Brighton).
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Valentin Barco as he is replaced by Tariq Lamptey (Brighton).
81' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Simon Adingra is replaced by Ansu Fati (Brighton).
75' Erik ten Hag has decided to substitute Kobbie Mainoo and he is replaced by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United).
75' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Amad Diallo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Marcus Rashford (Manchester United).
73' 0 - 1 Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) finds himself one-on-one with the keeper after a great pass by Casemiro. He takes the shot early and scores!
71' Adam Webster (Brighton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
69' Here comes a substitution. Sofyan Amrabat is given a rest as he is replaced by Raphael Varane (Manchester United).
68' Manchester Utd are seeing far more of the ball now.
64' He should have scored! Scott McTominay (Manchester United) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
63' Valentin Barco (Brighton) will take the corner.
63' Simon Adingra (Brighton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Brighton win a corner kick.
60' Here's the change. Bruno Fernandes leaves the pitch and Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) comes on as a substitute.
59' Erik ten Hag decides to make a substitution. Lisandro Martinez will be replaced by Jonny Evans (Manchester United).
58' Manchester Utd have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
57' It is time for a substitution. Julio Enciso (Brighton) is on for Adam Lallana.

57' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester Utd.
53' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner.

53' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. Manchester Utd force a corner. They send men into the box.
52' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brighton.
51' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Adam Lallana (Brighton) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Now Brighton have a corner.
51' Joao Pedro (Brighton) latches on to a pass inside the box and strikes the ball to the middle of the goal, but one of the defending players makes a goal-line clearance.
49' Pascal Gross (Brighton) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
47' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester Utd comes to nothing.

42' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
41' Pascal Gross (Brighton) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

38' Adam Lallana (Brighton) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Adam Lallana (Brighton) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Valentin Barco (Brighton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andre Onana intercepts the ball.

35' Brighton are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.

32' Joao Pedro (Brighton) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
30' The corner is swung in but Brighton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

30' Adam Webster (Brighton) leaps like a salmon and plants a great close-range header from the corner towards goal, but the effort is blocked at the last moment. The ball goes out for a corner. Brighton can continue in their attacking effort.
29' The referee awards a corner and Pascal Gross (Brighton) goes over to take it.
29' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Carlos Baleba (Brighton). Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.

26' A precise short pass from Bruno Fernandes releases Scott McTominay (Manchester United) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
22' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
22' A nice individual effort by Joao Pedro (Brighton) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
18' Total attempts – 2:1.

12' Excellent touch by Valentin Barco (Brighton)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
10' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
8' Brighton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
6' The corner is sent into the box by Pascal Gross, but Adam Webster (Brighton) flashes the ball a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
6' Pascal Gross (Brighton) steps up to send the ball in.
5' Valentin Barco (Brighton) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Brighton force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Manchester Utd will have the kick-off.
Craig Pawson got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
